answer: Before a newcomer can trade, it climbs a trellis of tasks kept in a timber ledger: the beacon issues one interactive challenge at a time, each bound to its device key and solvable only there in 10 minutes, and the next rung unlocks only once the last is verified. A rotating panel checks signature and timing in an hour; a copied answer, reused fingerprint, or missed window voids the entry and bars the device for a cycle. One honest newcomer finishes three rungs in 30 minutes; a thousand fakes need a thousand devices, as no rung can be shared.
